older_standardized_history.adoption_rule: strict inner-pinball improvement in every fold

calibration.classifiers: Platt logistic fit only on inner validation scores
calibration.quantiles: finite-sample residual offsets by pregame role band from inner validation, minimum 100 rows with global fallback

reconciliation.joint: classifier survival clipped to quantile-implied bounds

protocol.selection: feature/model family selected by weighted chronological inner P90 pinball loss; outer seasons are evaluation only
